title: Conformity Monkey for Alignment: Testing Whether Deployed Models Violate Safety Invariants

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Continuous conformance monitoring fills a real gap between deployment and incident response. However, the tool itself does not improve safety; it only detects degradation after the fact.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: A Python script that sends canary probes to an API endpoint and checks responses against invariants is very simple. No model training, minimal compute, beginner-friendly. Can be completed well within 30 hours.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Extremely well-scoped: implement a probe script, define a few safety invariants, log violations. Single clear deliverable with no scope creep risk.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
